Smoked
Two cigarettes a day = one microlife
Microlives table; the link between smoking and mortality is among the firmest in all of epidemiology
The figure is averaged over a population and over a smoker\'s whole life. One particular cigarette does not literally deduct anything
сигарета курить сижка табак дым smoke cigarette
Had a drink
One drink (10 g of alcohol)
Your value. The source is non-linear: the first drink of the day is +1 microlife, each of the next up to six goes negative
The norm now restores the source\'s shape: the first drink of the day helps, the rest cost
алкоголь бокал пиво вино бухло drink alcohol beer wine
Rested
A deliberate pause or breathing practice
Your value
No source has a row for deliberate rest. This is a motivational button, not a measured effect
отдых дыхание медитация пауза rest breathe meditation
Workout
First 20 minutes of moderate exercise, HR 0.81
Your value. The source gives twice as much: the first 20 minutes are 2 microlives (+60), the next forty add up to one more
You are undervaluing exercise twofold here. Set 60 to match the source
спорт зал качалка тренировка workout gym sport training
Slept under 7 h
Under 7 hours a night against the 7–8 reference
Meta-analysis, HR 1.14 → −1.43 microlives a day by the paper\'s formula. The curve is U-shaped: 9+ hours is worse still, HR 1.34
There is deliberately no «slept well» button: 7–8 hours is the reference point, not a bonus. Long sleep is almost certainly reverse causation — sick people sleep more
сон недосып мало спал не выспался sleep deprivation
Went to bed after 2 am
Definite evening chronotype against morning
UK Biobank, 433,268 people, 6.5 years. HR 1.10 → −1.04 microlives a day by the paper\'s formula
They measured self-described «owl or lark», not bedtime. And it is more about clashing with your work schedule than about the chronotype itself: later working hours remove part of the harm
сова поздно ночь режим сдвиг хронотип owl chronotype
Time with people
Not being socially isolated, per day

Meta-analysis: 148 studies, 308,849 people. Taken from OR 1.29 for isolation → +2.78 microlives a day. The «strong versus weak ties» contrast gives 1.50 but it is an extreme one and would overstate a single button
The largest plus in the list, and that is not a mistake: by effect size loneliness is comparable to smoking. But one tap does not move a person from isolated to connected
друзья общение встреча люди социальное social friends
Sex
+100 orgasms a year, men aged 45–59
Caerphilly, 918 men, 10 years. OR 0.64 → roughly +530 minutes per event by the formula. That is implausibly large, so a conservative figure at the level of a workout was taken instead
The number is mine, not the study\'s. Small and old sample (1997), self-reported, and almost certainly reverse causation: ill people have less sex, not the other way round
секс интим близость sex intimacy
A kilometre on foot
One kilometre of walking
Extended microlives table, +0.4 microlives per kilometre
This row is not in the BMJ paper itself, only in the retelling. It is consistent in order of magnitude with the main exercise row
ходьба прогулка шаги walk walking steps
A day outdoors
+0.1 NDVI of greenness within 500 m of home
Meta-analysis of cohorts, HR 0.96 → +0.45 microlives a day
They measured greenness around housing, not weekend trips. A one-off outing is not the same thing, so the figure is more symbolic than measured
природа лес парк зелень дача nature green outdoors
A day in smog
Living in Mexico City versus London, −0.6 microlives a day
A row from the microlives table

Important: a big city by itself is a plus, not a minus, in developed countries — city dwellers outlive rural ones and the gap is widening. The air is worse, but access to healthcare outweighs it. This button is about smog, not about cities
смог воздух грязь пыль выхлопы pm25 air pollution smog
Coffee
2–3 cups a day, HR 0.90
The table gives +1 microlife for 2–3 cups, hence a third of that per cup
Observational. Coffee is drunk by the employed and socially active — part of the effect is surely theirs, not the coffee\'s
кофе эспрессо капучино coffee espresso
Vegetables, one serving
≥5 servings a day, HR 0.66 in men
The table gives +4 microlives for FIVE servings; divided by five here

The shakiest row in the table. They measured not servings but blood vitamin C above 50 nmol/L — a marker that also flags people who live better overall. A third off mortality from vegetables is implausible as a causal effect
овощи салат фрукты зелень vegetables fruit salad
Red meat, 85 g
One 85 g (3 oz) serving a day, lifelong from age 35
Harvard cohorts, 121,342 people. HR 1.13 for unprocessed, 1.20 for processed

The serving is smaller than it sounds — about one burger patty. The weekly norm matters here: the studies measure an EXTRA serving on top of habit, so meat a couple of times a week is the baseline, not a sin
мясо стейк говядина свинина meat steak beef pork
Fast food
One burger
Named in the paper\'s text alongside a serving of meat and two cigarettes — one microlife
There is no separate table row, only a mention in the text. It is most likely the red meat row in other words
бургер фастфуд макдак картошка шаурма burger fast food
An hour of screen time
Two hours of television a day, HR 1.08
The table gives −1 microlife for two hours, hence half per hour
They measured television, not screens in general. The harm is attributed to sitting, so desk work probably counts the same
телевизор сериал ютуб скроллинг лежал tv screen scrolling
Time with a pet
A day with a cat or dog
A row from the extended table, +1 microlife
This row is not in the BMJ paper at all, and no study is cited for it. Trust it less than the rest
кот собака питомец гулял с собакой pet dog cat
Studied
A day of mental exertion
A row from the extended table, +4 microlives
Not in the BMJ paper, no study cited. And the figure is huge — second largest in the list. Too early to trust
мозг учёба чтение книга задача mind study learning
A glass of water
Serum sodium in the upper normal range, 11,255 people, 30 years
Zero is the result of checking, not a placeholder
The famous hydration study measured sodium in blood, not water drunk. That «drinking more water» extends life has not been shown. Drink when thirsty
вода стакан пить гидратация water hydration
Multivitamins
Daily multivitamin use
390,124 healthy people, over 20 years of follow-up. No mortality benefit — not all-cause, not cancer, not heart
This is about healthy people and about extending life. A proven deficiency of a specific vitamin is an entirely different matter
витамины бады таблетки добавки vitamin supplement
Sauna
4–7 sessions a week against one, HR 0.60
Kuopio cohort, 2,315 men, 20.7 years of follow-up

HR 0.60 is far outside the range the formula is promised for (0.75–1.3), so the number is inflated. The same journal ran a separate commentary arguing the link may be non-causal: frequent sauna-goers tend to be healthy and not working three jobs already
сауна баня парная хамам sauna steam
A handful of nuts
Nuts 7+ times a week against none, HR 0.80
Harvard cohorts, 118,962 people, with a clean dose-response: under once a week 0.93, two to four times 0.87, daily 0.80
Observational, and nuts are eaten by people with money and a habit of watching what they eat. The dose-response is smooth though, which is a good sign
орехи миндаль грецкие фундук nuts almonds
Cycled instead of driving
Commuting to work by bicycle, HR 0.59
UK Biobank, 263,450 people, 5 years
The largest plus in the list and the most suspect: HR 0.59 is far outside the formula\'s range, and people who bike to work are young, healthy and live close by. Treat it as an upper bound
велосипед вело самокат доехал bike cycling commute
Went for a run
Runners against non-runners, HR 0.70
55,137 people, 15 years. Even 5–10 minutes a day gives the same effect as more — the threshold is low
HR 0.70 is slightly outside the formula\'s range. And those who run are those who can: the ill do not run, and die more often
бег пробежка кросс run jogging
Fish, one serving
A serving of fish in place of red meat
Replacing red meat with fish is linked to lower mortality across all the large cohorts. A modest positive figure was taken
The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not
рыба лосось селёдка морепродукты fish salmon seafood
Sugary drink
Beyond two cans a week
Sugary drinks are consistently linked to diabetes and mortality. The figure was set slightly below a serving of red meat
The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not
газировка кола сок сахар лимонад soda sugary
Sweets
Beyond one dessert a day
A small figure was taken: one dessert a day is background, not a risk factor
The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not
сладкое десерт шоколад печенье торт sweets dessert
Heavy stress
A day of severe stress or conflict
Chronic stress is linked to mortality through the heart and through behaviour. For a single day a small figure was taken

The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not. And a one-off stressful day must not be conflated with chronic stress: it is the second that does the damage
стресс нервы конфликт ссора аврал stress conflict
Half an hour of reading
Half an hour of reading books
There is a well-known Yale study on book readers, but the figure here was set by me to sit beside neighbouring rows

The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not. Books are read by the educated and well-off — the effect is almost certainly not from the reading itself
чтение книга читал reading book
Flossed
Interdental cleaning for the day
Gum disease is linked to cardiovascular mortality. A small figure was taken

The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not. Causation is even shakier here than usual: people who look after their teeth look after everything else too
нить флосс зубы гигиена floss teeth dental
Tea
A cup of tea
By analogy with coffee, but more cautiously: the evidence base is weaker. A third of the coffee figure was taken
The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not
чай зелёный чёрный tea green
Daytime nap
A short sleep during the day
A short nap is usually linked to benefit, a long one to harm. A token figure was taken

The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not. Long daytime sleep goes negative in the studies, and that is more a sign of illness than its cause
дремота сон днём подремал nap daytime
Flu shot
A seasonal vaccination
One of the few rows here backed by randomised trials rather than observation alone. But converting it into minutes of life for a healthy 30-year-old is my estimate

The size was set by me to sit sensibly beside neighbouring rows, not taken from a study. The direction of the effect is widely accepted, the magnitude is not. The bulk of the benefit falls on the elderly and people with chronic illness
прививка вакцина грипп укол flu vaccine shot
